product.ta-22.summary: The TA 22 combined diskette data entry with local processing and data exchange with a data centre.
product.ta-22.history: Triumph-Adler offered it as an office terminal that prepared data and invoices at the workstation. Computerwoche documented a configuration with an IBM-compatible diskette in 1979.
product.ta-22.technical.configuration: The diskette held programs and data. The brochure gives 249 KB per disk and Computerwoche reports 242 KB. The brochure lists a display and cassette drive as options.
product.ta-22.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-22.technical.limitations: Firmware from an identified unit and program media are still needed to check operation.
